meta_title: Smith A Decorators | Painter & Decorator Newcastle
meta_description: Smith A Decorators Newcastle. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free quotes, no job too small, work guaranteed.
services_heading: Complete Decorating Services Across Newcastle & Gateshead
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to exterior transformations, we handle every decorating task with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and leave your rooms looking fresh and finished. Includes colour consultation.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Fascias, soffits, doors, windows, and rendered walls. Weather-resistant finishes protect your home for years. We work safely at height and respect your neighbours.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of all wallpaper types, including textured and specialty finishes. Seamless results and clean removal of old coverings.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Painting and staining of doors, skirting boards, architraves, and bespoke joinery. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a durable, smooth finish.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and rental properties. We work flexibly around your schedule and deliver quick turnarounds without compromising on quality.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Faux effects, Venetian plaster, chalkboard walls, and bespoke colour matching. Create unique, professional-looking spaces that stand out.

about_pullquote: We don't cut corners—every job gets the same care we'd give our own home.
about_para_1: Smith A Decorators was founded 12 years ago by a team frustrated with rushed, poor-quality work in the local area. What began as two experienced decorators has grown into a trusted name across Newcastle and Gateshead. We're fully insured, DBS checked, and committed to doing things the right way—proper prep, quality materials, and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals. We listen to what you want, give honest advice on colours and finishes, and we don't leave until you're happy. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full house renovation, we treat every project with the same professionalism and care.

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Craig and the lads came in, completely transformed our lounge and kitchen. They were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Even helped us choose the perfect colour scheme. Will definitely be calling them back for the upstairs.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our entire house exterior repainted. The fascias and soffits look like new. What impressed me most was how they protected the garden, cleaned up every day, and left no mess. Fair prices too. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Wallpapered two bedrooms and it looks perfect. No bubbles, seams are invisible, and they took great care with the pattern matching. They also sorted out some uneven walls beforehand without extra fuss. Top job.
reviews.author: James D.
